case_classification.short_description: More complicated debt waterfall model - monthly model including interest conventions

ai_time_estimate_reasoning: This is an extremely complex debt waterfall modeling task that requires tracking 300 monthly periods over 25 years. It involves multiple advanced elements, including day-count (Act/360, 30/360, Act/Act) and quoting (Nominal vs. EAR) interest rate conversions, five tranches of senior debt with customized arrears tracking and pro-rata payment allocation, convertible debt interest-to-equity conversions, revolver cash-float logic, and intricate equity dividend distribution rules. Specifically, the dividend distribution requires vintage-tracking of newly converted Class C shares to enforce their 4-year holding period alongside different share weightings and vesting schedules. Even for an expert modeler, setting up the recursive logic, tracking the share buckets, debugging the circular dependencies, and extracting the 35 specific data points for the Questions sheet will take approximately 5 hours of intensive building and auditing.
